title: Auxiliary Power Unit Aft Mount Link — Installation and Alignment Check
abstract: Installation of the auxiliary power unit aft mount link with the shim stack rebuilt in order, the spherical bearing seating check and the alignment measurement that closes the task.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the auxiliary power unit aft mount link, to rebuild the shim stack in the recorded order and to do the alignment measurement that confirms the unit position.
sections.job_setup_note: The shim stack must be rebuilt in the recorded order. Where the spherical bearing is fitted the bearing must be free to align before the attachment bolts are torqued; a bearing torqued while it is edge-loaded wears at the rate the plain bush did and the whole benefit of the standard is lost. The unit stays on the support sling until the alignment measurement has passed.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm the unit is supported on the sling. 2. Remove the protective plugs from both bores and clean them. 3. Where the spherical bearing is fitted, confirm the bearing rotates freely in its housing by hand. 4. Put the link in position and enter the attachment bolt at the unit end by hand. CAUTION: DO NOT DRIVE AN ATTACHMENT BOLT. A BOLT THAT DOES NOT ENTER BY HAND MEANS THE UNIT IS NOT AT THE RIGHT HEIGHT ON THE SLING. 5. Rebuild the shim stack at the bracket in the recorded order. 6. Enter the attachment bolt at the bracket end by hand. 7. Where the spherical bearing is fitted, let the bearing find its own alignment before you torque anything. WARNING: DO NOT TORQUE THE ATTACHMENT WHILE THE BEARING IS EDGE-LOADED. AN EDGE-LOADED BEARING WEARS AT THE RATE OF THE PLAIN BUSH IT REPLACED. 8. Torque both attachment bolts to the values in the figure and lockwire them. 9. Install the bearing seal where fitted. 10. Refit the drain line with the clamp clear of the bearing housing. 11. Do the alignment measurement at the datum given in the figure and confirm it is within limits. 12. Release the sling and repeat the alignment measurement with the unit weight on the mounts. 13. Reinstall the heat shield or refit the closing panel.
sections.close_out: Record the shim stack rebuilt, the link part number, both torque values and the two alignment measurements in the auxiliary power unit record. Do the auxiliary power unit ground run and confirm no abnormal vibration. Confirm the sling is removed and the tail cone access doors are closed and secured.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft carrying the steel link. Steps 3, 7 and 9 apply only to aircraft post MOD-149630.

safety_precautions: Keep the unit supported on the sling until the alignment has passed.
Do not drive an attachment bolt.
Confirm the tail cone is clear before the ground run.
